terms.comment: To dial a number: numerum (tēlephōnicum) sēligere (Traupman 38).

phrases.latin: Dā mihi, sīs, numerum tuum tēlephōnicum.
phrases.english: Give me your phone number, please.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 38, 39, 391, checked against the searchable text of the book (11 November 2026).
The example sentence marked “composed” is ours.
